title: Robin M NDE 3840
content: Flat lined - went to a place that was beautiful lit - like the sunshine but much prettier and more golden (kind of like sepia tones). Seemed like a neighborhood and I was shown around to all the people I loved and missed and they were all so happy. I remember being surprised like Oh, Hi - wow you're here how nice and smiling very broadly. Remember my dad sitting on a stoop of sorts with his hand outstretched to me. He was many years younger than he was when he died and I was just a toddler reaching up to him. I know I saw many people but can't remember who they were specifically except for my dad. Next thing I know the emergency medical technician is saying 'You died and we brought you back.' I said I saw my dad and that I couldn't die now because it was Christmas time and that would be too difficult a memory for my daughter to bear every Christmas.

elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Golden glow color that I have never seen before just beautiful.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don't remember actually hearing anything I just knew everyone was happy and smiling and at peace as was I.

elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Many others who were loved ones but can only name my dad. No words were spoken.

elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Very calm, very happy, smiling from ear to ear. The feeling of oh yeah this is great.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will

elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The overwhelming harmony of it all. The smiles on everyone's faces, the peace, and beautiful light.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Shared with others within twenty-four hours. They were interested and curious - wish I could remember more.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I had heard of it and had an experience related to me by my father before he died. I don't think it affected my experience.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I knew it happened and it has been a week and I still know it happened.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I feel different inside - kind of like 'floaty'.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Would love to undergo hypnotherapy to try and remember more. Don't fear death - it is peaceful, loving and welcomed when it happens.
